name: Beyond Vaelithra — Mission F
description: No Way Out. Five English homebrew profiles: Garran Vey, Mara Vell, Wizard Associate, Unstable Echo (optional), and Surveyor (shared rescue profile). CR/XP fields are placeholders. Encounter-limited uses and special effects require manual tracking. Not playtested.

actions.name: Arcane Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 60 ft., one target Garran can see. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Binding Field (2/Encounter)
actions.description: Garran creates a field of arcane force around one creature he can see within 30 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of Garran's next turn. The target can use its action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. This effect requires no concentration, and multiple uses of Binding Field on the same target do not stack.

actions.name: Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Containment Ward (2/Encounter)
reactions.description: When Garran or an ally he can see within 30 feet of him takes damage, Garran conjures a protective ward, reducing that damage by 1d6 + 2, to a minimum of 0. Garran uses this reaction after the damage is determined. The ward does not prevent any other effects associated with the damage.

additionalAbilities.name: Unstable Pattern
additionalAbilities.description: A creature that can see the echo within 30 feet of itself can use its action to make a DC 12 Intelligence (Arcana) check, disrupting the echo's pattern on a success. After the first successful check, the echo visibly flickers and dims. After the second successful check, the echo dissipates. The successes can come from different creatures, and a failed check does not remove any successes.

actions.name: Arc Discharge
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 30 ft., one target the echo can see. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) force damage.

actions.name: Flicker Burst (1/Encounter)
actions.description:
The echo releases a pulse of unstable energy at a point it can see within 30 feet of itself that is not behind total cover. Each creature in a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3 (1d6) force damage on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one.
